data.narrative:
Rebel Space is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Carrie and Gabriel Hernandez that has raised $2.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Stark Defence, UFORCE, Singularity, NODA AI) supplemented by 8 additional private frontier-defense firms and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS), spanning valuations from $125M to $4.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using $3M (total raised as proxy) with a 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier, yields $7M. Peer-median analysis across the 4 core comparables produced a $700M median valuation, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity in funding stage and technology maturity within the frontier-defense subsector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $6M to $805M, with a median of $354M. The $349M spread reflects fundamental uncertainty around Rebel Space's technical differentiation, customer traction, and pathway to defense commercialization relative to peers. Stage-progression implies a conservative floor; peer-median is highly sensitive to which comparables are deemed truly analogous. Critical uncertainties include revenue traction, IP defensibility, and regulatory pathway clarity in the defense sector.
